The Spring 2026 issue of the EADM Newsletter, with a column from the
President and an overview of the summer school and workshops EADM is
funding this year. In this issue:

1. Building Capacity in Decision Science – Mandeep K. Dhami
2. EADM-Funded Summer School and Workshops
    - 11th Behavioural Science Summer School: Understanding and Influencing Decisions
    - Decision Making Across the Lifespan: Judgments and Preferences
    - Overcoming the 'Double Standard' in Decision Research: How can we achieve representative sampling of stimuli and tasks?
    - European Group of Process Tracing Studies (EGPROC) Conference
